as_told.title: Thousands of agency documents on UFOs at nuclear bases

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says there are thousands of government documents from roughly 1945 to 1953 that describe UFOs turning up in America's most sensitive airspace, especially around nuclear sites. He says they come from the FBI (the federal police), the CIA (the foreign spy agency), the Army and its counter-intelligence corps. He also points to a government effort of that time called Project Twinkle, and he raises all this as proof that officials took the sightings seriously from the very start.
